messages:
Riley (People Ops): Quick sync for Noah's Day 1 (Mon 4/13). Need virtual I-9 verification, background check status, laptop courier, and W-4/direct deposit forms processed. Who can pick up which?
Devon (HR): I'll handle I-9 intake and run through remote verification. Noah will need to be on a video call with a verifier + present ID. I'll DM scheduling options. Also I'll send W-4 & direct deposit links.
IT-bot: Notebook request queued. Please confirm shipping address and whether to include dock & power adaptor. ETA 3 business days after approval.
Noah (newhire): Thanks — remote verification is fine. My shipping address: 82 Willow Ln, Apt 3B, Seattle, WA 98101. Passport & state ID available.
Riley (People Ops): @Logistics can you ship to that address? Also label device as "Noah - Eng" and include a QuickStart doc.
Logistics (Ops): Shipping OK. We'll ship standard dev MacBook, charger, and USB-C dock. Tracking will be posted in this thread once created.
Devon (HR): Background check vendor (VeriClear) shows "submitted". Usually completes 24-48h but sometimes longer for out-of-state records. Will update if any flags.
Priya (Hiring Manager): Heads-up: Noah is starting on a ramp week, no on-call. Please add him to eng-core Slack and repo access on day 1.
Riley (People Ops): Noted. IT, add Noah to org groups: eng-core, github-team, jira-dev. Also Okta invite + MFA required.
IT-bot: Okta invite will be sent after company email is provisioned. Email creation scheduled for Fri EOD.
Noah (newhire): One benefit Q: when's the enrollment window? I prefer dental + commuter.
benefits-bot: New hire open enrollment window is 30 days from start date. Benefits session scheduled Tue 4/14 10am PT. Calendar invite incoming.
Devon (HR): For remote I-9: please have passport ready OR driver's license + social security card. The verifier will ask to hold the ID up on camera and then complete Section 2. If you prefer in-person, we can arrange at HQ.
Riley (People Ops): Action items: Devon = schedule remote verifier & send payroll forms; Logistics = ship laptop, include QuickStart; IT = create email & Okta; Noah = confirm passport or DL+SSN and join verifier call.
Noah (newhire): Confirming passport. I'll be available Fri 9-11am PT for verification. Thanks!
Logistics (Ops): Shipment created: carrier FedEx, tracking 612345678901. Estimated delivery Fri. Posting tracking now.
IT-bot: Device image prepared. Provisioning script:
```
#!/bin/bash
# device bootstrap for new hire
enroll_device --user noah@redwood.com --profile dev
install_packages --list /opt/package-lists/dev.txt
enable_mfa --okta
```
Devon (HR): Background check cleared — no issues. Sending final welcome packet and payroll confirmation forms.
Riley (People Ops): All set. Last step: payroll needs bank info before first paycheck. @Noah please complete direct deposit within 3 business days. Also joining benefits session Tue 10am PT is optional but recommended. :slightly_smiling_face:
Noah (newhire): Done with direct deposit form. Thanks everyone — excited to start! :rocket:
